svg.aria-label: SmartShift. Team project · 2025. A shift-scheduling platform for hospitals: staff see their schedule, swap shifts through a two-step approval and get live notifications. A Node.js API and a React staff dashboard in one Nx monorepo, with an Angular admin portal.
